For the pixel-count branch, extract the production dimension predicate into a small helper called by openImage and test it directly at the boundary.
soft_bucket_findings.title: Make image limit test reach the limit guard
soft_bucket_findings.why_it_matters: The fixture changes only a one-pixel PNG header, leaving its compressed pixels inconsistent with the declared dimensions. ImageIO may reject it as invalid before the size guard, and the test explicitly accepts that result. Removing the image dimension limit could therefore leave this test green while oversized valid images proceed to raster creation.
soft_bucket_findings.demotion_reason: Keep one material primary testing finding for native extraction; this narrower guard-coverage scenario remains a consequential supplemental gap.
